verdict.rationale: Delegating tasks to AI is Skyvern's core function. Users run tasks from the dashboard by giving a natural-language goal and a starting URL. The product also has a built-in Copilot chat for building and debugging workflows, and an SOP upload that turns a plain-English process description into a workflow. Hands-on reports show it handles the happy path well but struggles on harder sites. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the Copilot chat assistant beyond a one-line mention, and independent corroboration of the in-product assistant experience.
